cohort: 652 infants born between 24 and 30 weeks gestation from March 31, 1996 to May 31, 2014
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a significant reduction in RDS among infants born at ≤ 30 weeks gestation compared to cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a significant reduction in RDS among infants born at ≤ 30 weeks gestation compared to cesarean delivery.
